question.problem:
Consider the vector space ${\text{M}}_{2}(R)$ of all $2\times 2$ matrices over $R.$

Which of the following statements are true?

I. $\{[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}0 & -1 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}]\}$ is a linearly independent set in ${\text{M}}_{2}(R)$

II. $[\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ -3 & -2\end{aligned}]$ can be expressed as a linear combination of $\{[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}0 & -1 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}]\}$

III. $\{[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}0 & -1 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}]\}$ is a basis of ${\text{M}}_{2}(R)$
